t: The LPvg Stack: Future-Proofing with Linux, Python, Vim, and Git
s: This article argues for building timeless technical skills around the LPvg stack (Linux, Python, Vim, Git) as a robust alternative to fragile, mainstream technologies, emphasizing persistent, portable digital environments.
sub: The LPvg stack as enduring technical foundation
Critique of mainstream virtualization (Docker) and containerization limitations
Nix as a key technology for persistent, portable digital homes
The concept of 'secret weapons' in technology: difficult but rewarding tools
